Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
Top Class Education Scheme for SC Students
1. What is the objective of the Scheme?
Answer: The Scheme aims to promote quality education among Scheduled
Caste (SC) students by providing financial support for pursuing studies
beyond Class XII in notified institutions.
2. Who is eligible?
Answer: SC students with annual family income up to Rs.8.00 lakh,
admitted in a full -time prescribed course in a notified institution, subject to
the allotted slots.
3. Who can apply for Fresh Scholarship?
Answer: Only first-year students admitted during the current academic year
are eligible for Fresh Scholarship.
4. Can second/third/fourth year students apply as Fresh?
Answer: No. Fresh Scholarship is available only to first-year students.
5. Which institutions are covered?
Answer: The Scheme covers notified institutions including IITs, NITs,
IIITs, IIMs, AIIMS, N LUs, IHMs, NIFTs, NIDs, Central Government

6. How are scholarships allotted?
Answer: Scholarships are awarded strictly on inter -se merit based on the
admission criteria prescribed for the course, subject to the number of slots
allotted to the institution.
7. What if eligible students exceed available slots?
Answer: Scholarship is restricted to students within the allotted slots. In
case of a tie for the last slot, preference is given t o the student having lower

8. Is there reservation for girl students?
Answer: Yes. Thirty percent of allotted slots are reserved for eligible SC
girl students. Unutilised reserved slots may be transferred to eligible boys as
per merit.
9. What documents are required?
Answer: Valid SC Certificate, Income Certificate, Aadhaar, Aadhaar-seeded
bank account details, admission details, admission rank and fe e details as
prescribed on NSP.
10. What are the income certificate requirements?
Answer: Self-employed parents: certificate by Revenue Officer not below
Tehsildar. Salaried parents: employer certificate and Revenue Officer
certificate for other income.
11. What financial assistance is provided?
Answer: Full tuition fee and non-refundable charges (up to Rs.2 lakh per
annum in private institutions), Academic Allowance of Rs.86,000 in first
year and Rs.41,000 per year thereafter.

12. How is scholarship released?
Answer: Scholarship is released through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT)
directly into the Aadhaar-seeded bank account of the student.
13. Is Aadhaar seeding mandatory?
Answer: Yes. Aadhaar-seeded bank account is mandatory for DBT.
14. How can students apply?
Answer: Students must submit applications online through the National
Scholarship Portal (NSP).
15. What is the role of the institute?

Answer: Institutes verify applications , ensure slot limits, verify documents
and forward eligible applications on NSP within prescribed timelines.
16. What is the last date for institute verification?
Answer: 31 October every year or any other date notified by DBT Mission.
17. Can more than two siblings receive scholarship?
Answer: No. Benefits are restricted to two siblings. An affidavit is required.
18. Can a student receive another scholarship?
Answer: No. A beneficiary cannot simultaneously avail similar scholarship
from Central/State Government.
19. What happens if a student fails?
Answer: Scholarship is withheld until promotion. Once promoted,
scholarship is restored automatically.
20. What happens if a student changes institute?
Answer: Scholarship under this Scheme is discontinued.
21. What happens if incorrect information is furnished?
Answer: Scholarship may be cancelled and recovery/action may be initiated
as per rules.
22. Can an institute be removed from the Scheme?

22. Can an institute be removed from the Scheme?

Answer: Yes. Institutions may be de -notified for violation of Scheme
provisions, non-participation for three consecutive years, absence of AISHE
code or NSP KYC, or other reasons as per guidelines.
23. Will existing beneficiaries continue if an institute is de-notified?
Answer: Yes. Existing eligible beneficiaries continue till completion of the
course. No fresh slots are allotted thereafter.

Answer: Latest Scheme Guidelines ar e available on the Department's
